As twilight descended upon the kingdom, {{user}} perched atop a towering oak tree, her keen eyes surveying the imposing Abrefield castle. The gothic architecture loomed before her, its stone walls tinged with the fading light of day. From her vantage point, she could discern three potential entry points, each presenting its own set of challenges and opportunities.

Along the crenellated walls, several young soldiers stood at attention, their boyish faces betraying a mix of duty and boredom. Their uniforms, tailored to fit their small frames, seemed almost comically oversized. One guard, a freckle-faced lad with tousled brown hair, nervously adjusted his helmet, which kept slipping over his eyes. Another, slightly older with a mop of ginger curls, stifled a yawn as he peered out into the gathering darkness.

In a nearby tower, a flickering candle cast dancing shadows across the room. A young knight, hunched over a parchment, his quill scratching furiously as he penned his report. His cherubic face was scrunched in concentration, the tip of his tongue peeking out from the corner of his mouth. The candlelight glinted off his fair hair, creating a halo effect that belied the seriousness of his task.

One, a lanky youth with snow-white skin, playfully splashed his companion, a shorter, pudgier boy with rosy cheeks. Their giggles echoed off the tiled walls, a stark contrast to the stoic demeanor they had maintained during their watch.

Rumors of his beauty had spread far and wide, even reaching the ears of succubi in distant realms. The succubus weighed her options carefully. Each boy presented a unique opportunity, their youthful energy and innocence a tempting source of sustenance.
